report_text:
The model expects 5-9 ft of visibility, resulting in a D grade. Conditions are marginal, with swell energy, surface movement and wind-driven mixing creating significant pressure on visibility.

Overall, visibility looks marginal. Divers should confirm local conditions before committing and favor sheltered coves or deeper water over shallow, sandy, or surge-exposed areas.
